description: Static marketing site for muush, a technology solution studio. Landing and About pages, in Spanish and English. Nuxt 4 + Vue, static output to S3 + CloudFront.

features.name: design_tokens_and_logos
features.title: Design tokens (colors, typography, fluid scale) and brand assets
features.description: Port the muush design tokens into the Nuxt app: the 5-step color ramps and the fluid type/space scale in app/assets/css/global.css, plus the isotipo and social SVG assets. Values come from docs/business/branding.md and docs/business/landing/design-extract.md § 9. The Astro implementation of this feature was discarded in the 2026-09-06 migration; the CSS itself carried over, so this is largely verification that it still resolves under Tailwind v4 inside Nuxt.
acceptance: app/assets/css/global.css exposes the exact 5-step hex ramps from docs/business/branding.md for red, wine, ink and bone
The fluid type and spacing scale resolves via clamp() across the desktop→mobile ranges in design-extract.md § 9, with no media query needed for sizing
font-poppins is scoped to logo/wordmark use only; font-instrument is the default for everything else
The 3 isotipo SVGs and 3 normalized social SVGs live under app/assets/ and are importable via the @/assets alias
A Storybook story renders the token set so the palette and scale can be reviewed visually
pnpm check, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm generate and pnpm storybook:build all pass

features.name: primitive_ui_layer
features.title: Primitive UI layer in app/shared/ui: GlassPanel, Radar, Wordmark, Lockup, Pill, BotonPrimario, LinkArrow, SocialIcon
features.description: Rebuild the eight design-system primitives as Vue SFCs in app/shared/ui/, matching the measurements in docs/business/landing/design-extract.md §§ 1-8. The Astro versions were discarded in the 2026-09-06 migration, but their prop contracts were sound and are recorded in git history on master; the Vue versions should expose equivalent surfaces. Per Constitution Article X every one of them needs a Storybook story.
acceptance: Eight components exist in app/shared/ui/ as Vue SFCs using <script setup lang="ts">: GlassPanel, Radar, Wordmark, Lockup, Pill, BotonPrimario, LinkArrow, SocialIcon
GlassPanel supports the 6 variants in design-extract.md § 1 with their exact fill/stroke/blur values
Radar supports the 3 sizes in design-extract.md § 2 (sm 20/14/7, md 30/20/12, sm-alt 22/16/10)
BotonPrimario supports the 3 size variants in design-extract.md § 4 and its LED border is the 3-stop conic gradient red-400 → bone-100 → red-400 (NOT wine), CSS-only, honoring prefers-reduced-motion
Wordmark renders both official lockups: muush and muush.dev
Every component has a Storybook story covering its variants (Constitution Article X)
Zero hardcoded hex or px literals in component markup (Constitution Article VII)
No page, layout or feature module is created — these are shared primitives only
pnpm check, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm generate and pnpm storybook:build all pass

features.name: site_shell
features.title: Site shell: Nav, Footer and mobile menu, wired into BaseLayout for both locales
features.description: Build the shell that wraps every page: Nav (desktop links + mobile hamburger), the full-screen mobile menu, and Footer with its 4 columns. All measurements come from docs/business/landing/design-extract.md § 9.bis — read that file, the Pencil MCP is not available to subagents. Verified in the design: Nav and Footer are byte-identical between Landing and Nosotros in both viewports, so each is ONE responsive component, not four. This is the first feature that produces visible output: it modifies BaseLayout and adds the /es/nosotros and /en/about routes so the nav links resolve instead of 404ing. Route strategy was decided 2026-09-06: both locales are prefixed (/es/, /en/), but the Nosotros segment stays translated (nosotros vs about), so the ES/EN toggle needs a route map that lives in src/i18n/, never hardcoded in Nav.
acceptance: Nav renders per design-extract.md § 9.bis: desktop shows Lockup + Proyectos + Nosotros + CTA nav + ES/EN toggle; mobile shows Lockup + ES/EN + hamburger, with NO CTA button (that is the documented decision, not an omission)

The mobile menu is a Svelte island in src/islands/ (it needs open/close state, background scroll lock, and Escape to close — genuine interactivity per Constitution Article II) and matches the MENÚ móvil abierto frame: full-screen glass panel, close X, 4 items at 30px, divider, 3 social buttons
Footer renders per design-extract.md § 9.bis with its 4 columns, brand block (Lockup + tagline + category) and bottom bar, reflowing from 4 columns on desktop to 2×2 on mobile
All shell copy (nav links, footer columns, menu items, copyright) lives in src/i18n/ui.ts with both es and en entries — zero hardcoded strings in components, per Constitution Article III

A route-mapping helper in src/i18n/ resolves the equivalent path in the other locale, translating the Nosotros segment (/es/nosotros ↔ /en/about) and preserving the anchor; it has Vitest unit tests per Constitution Article VII
BaseLayout renders Nav and Footer, so every page gets the shell; src/pages/es/nosotros.astro and src/pages/en/about.astro exist so nav links resolve

Reuses the feature 002 primitives (Lockup, Wordmark, Pill, BotonPrimario, SocialIcon) rather than reimplementing them; their prop contracts in specs/002-primitive-ui-layer/contracts/components.md are honored
Links with no destination yet (FAQ, Agenda una llamada) are handled per the open decisions in decisions-open.md — they must not render as broken links or 404s
pnpm check, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test and pnpm build all pass
